info.title: Furnivo HTTP API
info.description: A deliberately scoped contract for critical authentication, discovery, reservation, planner-cart, health, and job endpoints verified in the repository. It is not a complete API inventory. Other routes must be reviewed against their implementation and tests before client generation. No production hostname or external provider integration is configured. Merchant API-key records are not accepted by routes; no bearer-auth scheme is advertised.

servers.description: Local development or isolated CI only; no production origin is configured.

sessionCookie.name: live_token
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie. Secure is enabled in production; server-side session records support revocation. The token is not returned in JSON.

cronSecret.name: x-cron-secret
cronSecret.description: Server-side scheduler secret; required for production job endpoints. Never expose it to browser code.

mfaCode.description: Required when the account has MFA enabled.

SearchResponse.description: Search response shape is evolving; product objects include only fields selected by the route. This contract does not imply local stock is freshly confirmed or road distance is available.

RequestId.name: x-request-id
RequestId.description: Sanitized request correlation ID returned by the app. This is request correlation, not distributed tracing.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional client key used to deduplicate reservation creation for the same user and payload.

get.description: Returns coarse database and required-environment readiness only. Provider configuration flags and secret values are not returned.

200.description: Database and required configuration are available.

503.description: Database or required configuration is unavailable.

post.description: Invalid or unknown accounts receive the same generic credential error. On success, the session is set as an HttpOnly cookie; no token is returned in the JSON body.

200.description: Session created; Set-Cookie contains the session cookie.

401.description: Invalid credentials or MFA challenge required.

503.description: MFA secret is unavailable or unreadable; sign-in fails closed.

get.description: Returns {user:null} when signed out; private profile fields are not served from a public cache.

post.description: JSON clients receive 200. Native HTML form submissions receive a same-origin 303 redirect. The cookie is cleared and the server-side session is revoked where present.

303.description: HTML form redirect to the application root.

get.description: Supports GET and POST. Availability reflects current merchant records and reservation/batch exclusions; it is not proof of immediate local stock. Nearest uses straight-line distance when coordinates exist, not road distance. No sponsored rank is implied.

parameters.name: locationCode
parameters.description: Repeat for multiple selected administrative areas.

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Amount in NGN as interpreted by the search route.

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Amount in NGN as interpreted by the search route.

400.description: Unsupported location scope or invalid location selection.

post.summary: Search public product listings using JSON filters

200.description: Search results; same semantics and limitations as GET.

400.description: Unsupported location scope or invalid location selection.

200.description: Reservations owned by the current consumer.

post.summary: Create a pending pickup reservation request
post.description: Server-side authorization, branch, batch, price and inventory checks apply. A successful request creates a temporary stock hold immediately, before merchant confirmation. The reservation does not collect payment. Hold release requires the scheduled expiry process to be configured and operating.

200.description: Reservation created or idempotent duplicate returned.

400.description: Invalid or currently ineligible reservation request.

409.description: Stock snapshot changed during submission; refresh and retry.

422.description: Idempotency key reused with different request parameters.

get.summary: Read the authenticated user's planning cart
get.description: Totals are planning estimates. Unavailable or invalid variants are not added to the amount total. Delivery/service fees are not quoted or charged.

post.summary: Submit separate pending pickup reservations from the plan
post.description: Each item is revalidated independently. Successful items become separate reservations and temporarily hold stock; failed items remain in the plan. No multi-merchant order, payment, delivery, or fee is created. Pickup windows are not invented or automatically populated.

200.description: Per-item created/failed result; partial success is possible.

400.description: No active plan or no plan items.

post.description: Requires x-cron-secret. Runs implemented saved-search/price alerts and webhook delivery; generic BackgroundJob handlers remain unsupported and are reported as such. This is not a hosted scheduler.
